purpose: Progressive, reversible selection scaler for finite vector data. Returns deterministic index subsets at a given scale fraction. Pay-per-request via x402 USDC on Base.
benefit: Deterministic progressive data subset selection with coverage statistics. Reversible and composable.
risk_if_not_used: Manual index selection is non-deterministic and not reversible across scale changes.

harm_analysis.ambitions: Enables progressive data loading and scalable agent data pipelines
harm_analysis.relationships: Composable with Shared Hold API for storing scale results
harm_analysis.money: Fixed cost 0.02 USDC per scale operation

next_recommended.reason: Store the selected_indices result to Shared Hold for cross-agent retrieval.
